name: Japanese
blurb: Read hiragana and katakana, then build JLPT N5 vocabulary and polite です/ます Japanese: the particles は が を に で へ の も, present and past verb forms, the て-form, and い and な adjectives.

sources.t: Tae Kim's Guide to Learning Japanese
IRODORI: Japanese for Life in Japan, The Japan Foundation
JLPT N1 to N5 level summary, Japan Foundation and JEES
